name: CF Ursae Majoris
description: A naked-eye star 9.1 parsecs away, 68% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 103095: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.696 +/- 0.005 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.681 +/- 0.006

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 103095: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 4759 +/- 20

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 103095: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 109.98 +/- 0.41 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 9 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 68% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.696 milliarcseconds, which gives 0.681 solar radii and 4,759 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 103095: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
